title: Dashboards
intro: Widgets on a grid, in sections: the floor plan zoomed to an area with the layers you pick, widgets, tiles and your own text. Split a widget to put panes side by side. Open one full screen on a TV.
name: Name
cycleHint: Plan panes showing a whole hall without a fixed hall
stale: No connection to the server: showing what was last read.
canvasHint: Drag a widget by its handle, resize it by its corner (with the keyboard: arrows, Shift+arrows). Click it to set it up or split it. At most {{max}} widgets on {{cols}} columns.

edit.moveHint: Drag to move. Arrow keys move it, Shift+arrows resize it.

form.label: Pane settings
form.pickOne: Pick a pane on the left to set it up.
form.title: Title
form.titleHint: Optional; plan panes name their hall and area by themselves.
form.hallHint: Empty: the first hall (or all of them in turn)
form.noBlocks: This hall has no seat blocks.
form.noZones: This hall has no zones yet. Draw one on the plan (Zone tool) and give it a label, for example VIP.
form.boxHint: Move and zoom the plan to the part this pane should show, then keep it.
form.noTiles: No tiles. Turn on a plugin with tiles under Settings > Plugins.
form.marksHint: Public: only the Overview and Safety marks, for a screen people walk past.
form.expandedHint: With its filters and details, for a pane that fills a screen.
form.levelHint: Automatic picks small, medium or large from the size of the box.
form.alsoHint: Up to three more tiles: their lines join the graph, their numbers the bars.
form.reduceHint: Turns the data into one number (one per line for a graph).
form.reduceGroupHint: One number per group, from the first number column (a count without one).
form.legendHint: Empty: the latest value, plus max and average when large.
form.noWidgetsHint: No saved widgets yet. Make one on
form.widgetHint: The pane follows the widget: a change on the Widgets page shows here too.
form.cloneHint: Makes a tile of its own with the same settings, for this dashboard only. It no longer follows the widget.
form.compareDayHint: A dotted line: yesterday at the same times, by the hour.
form.eventsHint: Switches going down or coming back, and incidents, as lines on the graph.
form.sparkHint: A small line of how it went, when the pane is too small for the graph.
form.changeHint: An arrow with how much it moved since an hour ago (or since the start of the data).
form.textSizeHint: The big number of a number, gauge or pie, for a wall seen from afar or a crowded screen.
form.refreshHint: How often this pane asks again. Faster means fresher numbers and more load.

pane.failed: Couldn't load the plan. Trying again.
pane.noPlan: This hall has no plan yet.
pane.areaGone: The part of the hall this pane shows is gone. Edit the dashboard to pick another.
pane.tileGone: This tile is gone (plugin off or removed).
pane.noText: Write something in the pane's settings.
pane.private: Needs an account: not shown on a public screen.
pane.viewOff: This widget's feature is turned off (Settings > Features).
pane.dropped: Left out, doesn't fit with the first tile: {{names}}
pane.widgetGone: This saved widget is gone. Edit the dashboard to pick another.

frame: Header and status line in full screen

attention.hint: Open an incident or mute it to clear this

large.backAfter: Goes back by itself in {{seconds}} s · Esc

section.title: Section title
section.empty: No widgets here yet: add one, or remove the section.

publicHint: Opens without signing in, for a screen in the hall. Shows the plan, switch and seat counts, the switches down and texts; other panes need an account.

display.title: Numbers and colours
display.thresholdsHint: From a value up, the number, bar or gauge takes a colour. Graphs show them as lines.
display.mappingsHint: A value or range shows as a word instead, such as 0 as "Down".
display.axisHint: Fixed ends keep graphs on a wall comparable; values outside sit on the edge.
display.yLog: Log scale (for values far apart, like bytes)
display.seriesHint: Rename, recolour or hide one, found by its name in the data.

refresh.auto: As the tile sets it (every {{seconds}} s)

boardRangeHint: Every graph that can, unless its pane picks its own. Viewers can change it for themselves.
